data.turoyo: Mərle omər: "Mədle d mčakčək ruḥe" — omər, — "ḥḏənli."
data.translation: He said, he says, "He began girding himself up," he says. "I grappled with him."

rationale: Infectum sense 1 still has one example after round 1; adds unprefixed d-complement with ruḥe and a fighting context. English is supplied project MT.

summary: Beide Belege bestätigen bestehenden Sinn 1: reflexives Sichaufschürzen als Vorbereitung zum Losgehen und transitives Aufkrempeln der Ärmel vor dem Pflücken.
Ruḥe in 96/81 ist ein ausgedrücktes Reflexivobjekt aktiver I-Form, kein Beleg einer neuen Detransitive. Die vierkonsonantige Wurzel bleibt im überlieferten Stamm I.

Die beiden kurdischen etymologischen Vergleiche bleiben unverändert nebeneinander stehen; diese Wiederholungsbelege entscheiden nicht zwischen ihnen. Für Sinn 2 und den schon vorhandenen Infinitiv ergibt sich keine neue Evidenz.

Round 2, Jan Beṯ-Şawoce. Supplied English is project machine translation [MT], not an edition translation; all semantic decisions are based on the Turoyo. Only this round’s proposals are encoded here. Round-1 proposals remain separate.
The d-complement after Mədle supplies an unprefixed Infectum example. Ruḥe is the expressed reflexive object of active I and does not license a Detransitive section.
The combat setting extends the context of getting oneself ready; the current sense aufkrempeln, aufschürzen already covers it. Nothing here supports sense 2 durchlöchern.
Retain the existing I stem label and both inherited Kurdish comparisons exactly; this new token does not decide the etymology. No independent light-verb collocation is proposed.
Check the subject substitution in the quotation from 96/81
rationale: The quoted predicate gə-mčakčək ruḥe is present at the cited verse, but the supplied corpus continues with the subject Nari, not u kurrəko. This is a replacement of a word, beyond spelling normalization. The example also cites grammar page 797, which may account for the generic subject; that page is not supplied for comparison. Establish whether this is an intentional grammar-version adaptation before changing the quotation. The verse reference itself is valid.

summary: Jan confirms the active reflexive-object construction noted in round 1: mčakčək ruḥe in preparation for action, here in a fight. No Detransitive or new numbered sense.
